titre: Practice test — English (6th year primary) — Term 2

exercices.enonce:
Read the text:
Mrs Hedia is a baker. She works in a small bakery in the old town. Every morning, she wakes up at four o'clock and makes bread and cakes. Her son Ahmed is a mechanic. He repairs cars in a garage. Right now, Mrs Hedia is baking bread and Ahmed is fixing a car engine. They are both tired but happy at the end of the day.

Answer:
1) What is Mrs Hedia's job? (1 pt)
2) What time does she wake up? (1 pt)
3) What does Ahmed do? (1,5 pt)
4) What is Ahmed doing right now? (1,5 pt)

Complete with the present simple or present continuous:
1) She (wake up) ...... at four o'clock every day.
2) Look! She (bake) ...... bread now.
3) He (repair) ...... cars every day.
4) Right now, Ahmed (fix) ...... a car engine.
5) They (be) ...... tired at the end of the day.

Match each job with the place:
1) baker    a) garage
2) mechanic b) bakery
3) nurse    c) office
4) engineer d) hospital
